policy.ending_periods: Omitted when tone or 21x3 layout calls for it; no period sweep.
policy.large_numbers: Narrative 1万2000 and 1亿2000 become 一万两千 and 一亿零两千; other measured quantities remain numeric.
policy.ellipsis: Single marks become the normal two-mark pause; merged four-mark pauses become two; source three-mark silences keep three; one source eight-mark ending keeps four.
policy.ascii: Only prose punctuation and scene dividers change; runtime placeholders, identifiers, titles, time, percentages, and ratios retain exact symbols.
